pipe.name: Umugqa wepayipi
symbol.name: Uphawu lwesikimu
table.name: Uhlu lwamapayipi
table.title: Uhlu lwamapayipi
solid.name: Ipayipi {tag}
cmd.pipe.help: Dweba umugqa wepayipi phakathi kwawo: khetha impahla, isigaba kanye nosayizi osemthethweni; amagxobo, izinciphisi kanye nama-tee kuza ngokwawo
cmd.valve.help: Beka amavalvu, izihlungi, ama-flange kanye neziyunoni emigqeni yamapayipi (noma uwasuse)
cmd.pidsym.help: Beka izimpawu zesikimu: amavalvu, iphampu, ivalvu yokukhulula, amabhaluni wezilinganiso, imicibisho yokugeleza
cmd.pipesched.help: Uhlu lwamapayipi nezingxenye zawo, lubekwe njengethafula elizibuyekeza ngokwalo
cmd.pipe3d.help: Yakha futhi izinto eziqinile zawo wonke amagatsha amapayipi kuthebhu ye-3D
ask.pipe.first: Iphoyinti lokuqala lomugqa wepayipi ({size}); qala kupayipi ukuze uhlanganise kulo
ask.pipe.next: Iphoyinti elilandelayo ({size}); phela kupayipi ukuze uxhume kulo
ask.table: Lapho kuzobekwa uhlu (ekhoneni lalo elingaphezulu kwesobunxele)
done.table: Uhlu lubekiwe. Ilandela amapayipi njengoba eshintsha.
done.3d: Izinto eziqinile zakhiwe futhi: amagatsha amapayipi {n}.
done.3d.off: Izinto eziqinile zivaliwe ezilungiselelweni › CadCraft › Ipayipi.
warn.slope: Umsele ohlezi ngaphansi kwesiphezulu sekhodi yamapayipi ngokuthambeka okuncane kakhulu kosayizi wawo ({need}).
warn.flat: Umsele ongalingene: ikhodi yamapayipi idinga okungenani {need} ngosayizi wawo.
warn.short: Isigaba sifushane kakhulu ngezingxenye zaso: ziyahlangana.
warn.hairpin: Igatsha liphenduka libuyela emuva kuzo ekhoneni: igxobo alikwazi ukudwetshwa lapho.
warn.maxpts: Igatsha linamaphoyinti angu-100 kuphela: lona liphela lapha. Qala igatsha elisha kusukela ekugcineni kwalo.
err.slope: Lokho akuwona ukuthambeka: thayipha amainchi ngamafidi (1/4) noma amaphesenti (2%).
err.run: Lo mugqa awukwazi ukudwetshwa: udinga amaphoyinti amabili ahlukile.
pack.name: Amapayipi: {name}
pack.description: Izinto zamapayipi, zezingxenye namavalvu zedwebo elilodwa le-CadCraft; ipayipi lensimbi nesisindo salo. Akukho izinga: lisethe wena.
pack.assume.pipe: Ubude kusukela phakathi kuya phakathi kwezingxenye, ngokuthambeka; isisindo sensimbi siyisisindo sesiphelo esilula ngokwe-ASME B36.10M.
pack.assume.count: Eyodwa ngengxenye noma ivalvu ngayinye edwebweni; okuxhumayo (ukushisela, ukuthambisa, i-solvent) akubalwa.
pack.source.drawn: Ubude obulinganiselwe edwebweni, phakathi kuya phakathi kwezingxenye
panel.none: Akukho migqa yamapayipi okwamanje: thayipha PIPE.
cmd.pipenet.help: Ukunikeza amanzi kusuka endaweni yomthombo: ukugeleza, isivinini kanye nengcindezi elahlekile kuthelo ngalinye kusuka emayunithini ezinto zokuthela onikeza wona (PNET)
net.source: Umthombo: chofoza ekugcineni komugqa wepayipi lapho kufika khona ukunikezwa [Ingcindezi/Setha kabusha]
net.fixture: Ithelo ekugcineni {tag} ({x}, {y}): {list}, noma inani lamayunithi ezinto zokuthela (0 = akukho)
net.err.source: Leli phoyinti alisendaweni yokugcina komugqa wepayipi. Chofoza ekugcineni lapho kufika khona ukunikezwa.
net.err.noends: Akutholakalanga ukuphela kwamapayipi okukhululekile, ngakho akukho lapho amanzi angahamba khona.
net.err.nosrc: Qala i-PNET kuqala, bese uchofoza umthombo, bese uthumela.
net.note.nofixture: Ukuphela {tag} {key} akunalo ithelo, ngakho akuthathi manzi.
net.note.loop: Kutholakale izilobo zamapayipi {n}. Ukubalwa kulandela isihlahla, ngakho izilobo ziyanganakwa.
net.head: Izinto zokuthela {n}. Okukude ngokwengcindezi: {worst}.
net.sizes: Imigqa {n} incane kakhulu ngokugeleza kwayo (iyashesha) noma mikhulu kakhulu kunaleyo edingekayo: {list}.
net.beyond: Eminye imfuneko ingaphezu kwesiphetho sevini lokufuna. Thayipha ivini lekhodi yakho ukuze uqhubeke.
net.defaults: Imfuneko isebenzisa ivini lokuzenzakalelayo elibhalwe igama, nokulahleka kwezingxenye kuyizinombolo ezizenzakalelayo ezijikelezwe. Hlola nonjiniyela wakho ngaphambi kokuthembela kuzo.
